console.all: Segment of the console level filter that shows every level.
console.filter: Accessible label of the console level filter.
console.emptyDescription: console.log() is code and stays as written.
visualize.frameTitle: Title of the frame that shows output a script draws, for example a chart.
preview.blocked: Notice above a rendered HTML response. Remote content is blocked for privacy.
preview.load: Button that allows images, styles and fonts from other addresses in the preview.
preview.block: Button that blocks remote content again.
errorTitles: Titles shown when a request could not produce a response.
errorTitles.restricted: The request was refused because the folder it belongs to is not trusted yet.
errorTitles.blocked: The address was refused, for example a private network address on the web version.
response.copyBaseUrl: Tooltip of the button that copies the address of the local mock or capture server.
response.bodyLabel: Accessible label of the text area that holds the response body.
response.formatAnyway: Button on a very large body: format it although it may take a while.
response.formatting: Shown while a large body is being formatted.
response.formatFailed: {{reason}} is the technical reason; leave it as it is.
response.saveToFile: Button that saves the response body as a file.
response.findInBody: Placeholder and label of the search box over the response body.
response.noMatches: Search result count when nothing matches.
response.matchPosition: Position of the current search match, for example 3 of 12.
response.matchPositionCapped: Same, when the search stopped counting; the plus sign means there are more matches.
response.filterPlaceholder: Placeholder of the JSONPath filter. $.data[0].id is an example expression and stays as written.
response.truncated: {{size}} is a size such as 5 MB. The response was cut because the app keeps at most that much of one response.
response.tabs.tests: Tab with the results of checks (assertions). Matches the term used for checks elsewhere.
response.tabs.timeline: Tab that shows where the time of a request went.
response.tabs.visualize: Tab that shows output drawn by a script.
response.views.pretty: View of the body formatted for reading.
response.views.raw: View of the body exactly as received.
response.views.preview: View of the body rendered, for HTML, images and similar.
response.bodyView: Accessible label of the Pretty, Raw, Preview switch.
response.checksPassed: Read by screen readers next to the check count badge.
response.history.menu: Menu of earlier responses to the same request.
response.history.comparedWith: Accessible label of the arrow between two responses being compared: the first compared with the second.
response.history.compareParts: Accessible label of the switch between comparing bodies and comparing headers.
response.history.bodyPart: Choice in the comparison: compare the response bodies.
response.history.headersPart: Choice in the comparison: compare the response headers.
response.columns.httpOnly: Cookie attribute name; keep as written.
response.columns.secure: Cookie attribute: only sent over HTTPS.
response.sessionCookie: Shown in the Expires column of a cookie that ends with the browser session.
response.saveExample: Button that saves this response as an example of the request.
response.searchBody: Tooltip; {{shortcut}} is the keyboard shortcut and stays as written.
response.resizeHint: Hint of the drag handle between the request and the response.
response.sending: Accessible label of the loading placeholder while a request is in flight.
response.emptyDescription: {{status}} is the status line, for example 204 No Content.
response.binaryDescription: {{type}} is a MIME type such as application/pdf.
response.treeTrimmed: Raw and the filter are the names of controls in the response toolbar.
response.error: Short badge shown instead of a status when a request produced an error.
response.milliseconds: Duration in milliseconds; {{value}} is a number.
response.more: Menu button that shows more response actions.
response.tabs.body: Tab name: the body of the response. Noun.
response.columns.name: Column heading: the name of a header or cookie.
response.columns.value: Column heading: the value of a header or cookie.
response.columns.path: Column heading: the path attribute of a cookie.
